title: Does Humidity Raise or Lower Blood Pressure?
description: High humidity can cause blood pressure to drop by up to 10 mmHg in adults over 35—learn why and how to stay stable when it’s hot and sticky.
reasoning: This query is trending due to summer heatwaves across North America and Europe, where adults 35+ are noticing dizziness, fatigue, and erratic home BP readings during humid spells—and urgently want practical, non-medical explanations and actionable steps to protect themselves.

title: Does Heat Lower Blood Pressure? What Adults Over 35 Should Know
description: Yes—heat can drop systolic BP by 5–10 mmHg in adults 35+. Learn when it’s normal vs. risky (especially if dizzy or 90/60), and how to stay safe this summer.
reasoning: This query is trending due to early summer heatwaves causing real-world symptoms (dizziness, fatigue) in middle-aged and older adults—many are noticing lower readings or orthostatic drops and worrying about hypotension or medication adjustments. They want practical, age-specific guidance—not just physiology—but what to do, when to act, and whether their numbers are truly concerning.
